entries.headline: Iranian radar-site explosion report relayed
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a report from @weslester6474 of an explosion involving an Iranian radar installation near Tabriz in East Azerbaijan Province. The visible post was truncated and did not state that the report had been confirmed.

entries.headline: U.S. transport aircraft activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six U.S. Air Force transport aircraft airborne over the continental United States and beyond, with no coded radio broadcasts detected during that hour.

entries.headline: Vinnytsia apartment-building strike report highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted a Suspilne report that a Russian Army drone strike hit a five-storey building in Vinnytsia and injured six people, saying two outlets later confirmed the report.

entries.headline: U.S. transport aircraft over North Sea and United States reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six U.S. Air Force transport aircraft airborne, including three over the North Sea and two over the United States, with no coded military radio broadcasts heard in the previous hour.

entries.headline: U.S. transports over North America and North Sea reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six U.S. Air Force transport aircraft airborne over the continental United States and North Sea, including one large cargo aircraft, during an otherwise quiet period with no coded radio broadcasts heard that hour.

entries.headline: Tel Aviv inquiry rally report highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted a Jerusalem Post report that more than 100,000 people rallied in Tel Aviv demanding a commission of inquiry into failures during October 7. The item was credited to reagan0965.

entries.headline: Boeing E-6 Mercury sighting reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported a Boeing E-6 Mercury with no displayed call sign and hex code AE868C. The sighting was credited to reagan0965.

entries.headline: Iranian attack-preparation assessment relayed
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a contributor report that U.S. intelligence assessments suggested Iranian preparations to attack Americans in the Middle East had reached advanced stages, according to U.S. officials. The visible post was truncated after that point.

entries.headline: U.S. heavy transports and elevated UK activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six U.S. Air Force heavy transport aircraft airborne and military aviation activity over the United Kingdom and North Sea at nearly three times the usual level.

entries.headline: E-11A departure preparation reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported a Bombardier E-11A with no displayed call sign and hex code AE77A5 preparing to leave Prince Sultan Air Base in Saudi Arabia. The sighting was credited to az-toaster.

entries.headline: U.S. command, transport and coded-radio activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported a U.S. military nuclear-command aircraft airborne over the country alongside four large transport jets and a refuelling tanker, with 21 coded radio broadcasts heard that day.

entries.headline: U.S. command, transport, radar and tanker activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported a U.S. Air Force nuclear-command jet, two large transport aircraft, an airborne-radar aircraft and a refuelling tanker simultaneously airborne over the continental United States. The remainder of the visible post was truncated.

skyglass.caption: Military aircraft movement reports.

entries.headline: BACE week business-jet totals reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 1,040 distinct business jets in the Las Vegas valley during BACE2026 week, with activity peaking at 306 on Thursday before falling 19% on Friday. It shared a reel covering six days of after-action reports.

entries.headline: BACE departure-heavy traffic reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 309 departures and 154 arrivals on its Las Vegas valley counter by 2:30 p.m. ET as BACE2026 wrapped Friday, saying there were about two departures for every arrival. It shared a 60-times-speed replay.

entries.headline: BACE Friday business-jet activity comparison posted
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported business-jet activity down 19% Friday compared with Thursday as BACE2026 wrapped and shared a whole-day scan.

entries.headline: BACE business-jet arrivals and impact estimated
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 935 business-jet arrivals, 52% above a normal October week, and estimated that they represented about $13.5 million of BACE2026's roughly $50 million Las Vegas impact.

entries.headline: BACE departure surge reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 259 departures from four Las Vegas-area fields by 1:43 p.m. ET, compared with 116 arrivals, and shared a time-lapse covering 10:17 a.m. to 1:29 p.m. ET.

entries.headline: BACE departure and arrival counts shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 120 departures and 48 arrivals across four Las Vegas fields by 12:15 p.m. ET on Thursday during BACE2026, and shared a 30-times-speed replay.

entries.headline: BACE Thursday traffic comparison posted
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported business-jet activity up 10% while overall Las Vegas valley traffic fell 3% on Thursday compared with Wednesday, and shared a whole-day scan.

entries.headline: Las Vegas field departure count reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 243 aircraft still on the ground across four Las Vegas fields at 10:16 a.m. ET Friday, with 61 already departed.

entries.headline: NBAA-BACE peak-hour replay shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a 30-times-speed replay covering 28 minutes of Wednesday’s NBAA-BACE peak traffic across Harry Reid, Henderson, North Las Vegas and Boulder City, followed by a valley-wide view.

entries.headline: N871CB Boulder City arrival replay shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared the Wednesday NBAA-BACE arrival of Citation CJ2 N871CB into Boulder City, showing the approach at ten-times speed and the touchdown in real time.

entries.headline: Henderson NBAA-BACE business-jet traffic reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 81 business jets at Henderson on Wednesday during NBAA-BACE, compared with 172 at Harry Reid, highlighting overflow traffic handled by the valley’s reliever airfields.

entries.headline: Las Vegas NBAA-BACE traffic comparison posted
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported Las Vegas business-jet activity up 13% on Wednesday during NBAA-BACE while overall traffic eased by about 5%, citing SkyGlass MCP data.
